Inkling v2 — optional remotely loaded display font

Author: eli / frozenpandaman
Source and terms: https://frozenpandaman.github.io/inkling.html
Pinned font revision: 70f9b936a841672da15d1342ad99db63d3c50229

The author states:
“THIS FONT MAY NOT BE USED FOR COMMERCIAL PURPOSES.
PLEASE GIVE CREDIT IF USED.”

Salmon Review uses this font only in its optional, non-commercial Inkling
display mode. The font is not included in the repository, Docker image or
installer and is not licensed under Salmon Review's AGPL-3.0-or-later license.
Do not infer permission to redistribute, sublicense or use it commercially.
Remote loading does not waive the author's conditions or any underlying rights.

The browser requests the pinned font from cdn.jsdelivr.net only when Inkling
labels are displayed. The font host receives the usual network request
information (including IP address); records and credentials are not sent.
Requests use the application's no-referrer policy. If loading fails, ordinary
English remains readable. Font data may be cached by the browser.

Inkling is an ornamental character mapping over English, not an official or
deciphered language translation. The whole interface and chart exports use it;
other language names in the selector keep their ordinary fonts. Unsupported
characters fall back without changing their text. Inkling exports are PNG only.
Font data is used in memory while rasterizing; the downloaded PNG contains pixels
and a visible author credit, not an embedded font file. Downloadable SVG is
disabled in this mode. This does not remove the non-commercial and attribution conditions.

鱿鱼语模式使用 eli / frozenpandaman 的 Inkling v2 字体。
作者要求非商业使用并署名。字体通过 CDN 按需加载，不随项目或安装包分发，
不适用本项目的 AGPL 许可；远程加载不免除作者条件及相关权利要求。
字体仅作装饰，并非真正的语言翻译。页面加载失败时显示正常英文。
鱿鱼语仅导出 PNG，并保留可见署名；字体只在内存中用于绘制，不嵌入下载文件。
不提供鱿鱼语 SVG。导出时字体加载失败则终止，不静默替换显示效果。
